text:
At handover, the weekend team read your clear note with care and saw that your companion animal travel arrangements were not handled with the consistency and respect you were promised. We are treating this matter as urgent because your trust in Aurelia Skyways depends on a swift and careful response.

We regret the distress caused by the confusion around your booking and the service steps that should have been explained in plain terms before travel. The Companion Animal Travel Desk has reviewed the desk ledger and the service notes already available to us, and we are taking immediate action to clarify what was recorded, what was missed, and what follow-up should have been offered. Our passenger coordinator team is responsible for making each journey clear, and when that standard is not met, we must address it without delay.

Please be assured that your case is not being treated as routine. A companion animal journey is a shared responsibility between the traveler, the desk, and the staff who confirm the arrangements, and we understand how serious it is when that chain breaks. We are now checking the service changes logged by staff, confirming the required travel steps, and ensuring that any guidance given to you is complete, accurate, and respectful. If further review is needed, it will be handled directly by the desk rather than left unresolved.

If Baxter traveled with you, we also want to recognize the added concern that arises when a pet's welfare is placed in doubt. Your confidence matters, and so does the calm and safe handling of every animal under our care. We are escalating this internally so the issue receives proper attention from the responsible team and does not pass between departments without ownership.

We apologize for the upset and the inconvenience this has caused. You should expect a clear and accountable follow-up from Aurelia Skyways, and we will continue pressing for a fair resolution until the matter is properly closed.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
